title: Write a budget pick in CP-SAT
heading: MathOpt, CP-SAT and the Linear Solver Wrapper Each Take a General Model
cases: on whole-number data the pick has the most value any affordable set has
the pick costs no more than the budget and lists indices in increasing order
costs with two decimals are compared at full precision, so three items of 1.40 do not fit a budget of 4.00
items whose costs add up to exactly the budget all fit, although the budget times 100 is not exactly a whole number in floating point
